description: WiFi channel congestion scanner for CardputerZero

store.summary: See how crowded each WiFi channel is, on 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz.
store.description: WiFi Tools scans nearby networks every few seconds and shows a bar per channel with how many networks use it, the strongest signal, overlapping 2.4 GHz networks, and the channel load that access points advertise. Use it to pick the least congested channel for your own access point.
